name: m0-agent-cli
description: docs/specs/builtin-agent-cli.md, e2e: the built-in agent's CLI mode in the chat window, with the fake Claude Code (tests/browser/fake_vimma_agent_cli.py) installed as claude, alone on PATH beside the system folders, and the real vimma-ctl mcp, under a fixture Omarchy theme. :agent model, then the add: agent CLI row (the third row: the add rows come before any local server setup finds), lists the CLI setup found on PATH, claude 2.1.303 and its path (m0-agent-cli-setup-list); Enter picks it and Enter keeps the suggested model, sonnet. A task of three items is typed and sent with Enter, and y answers the first task's notice: the fake runs its own Bash tool, then, under the grant, opens shop.html and lists its elements, and activates 'Vahvista tilaus' (s), which stops at the payment checkpoint even under a grant; the header lists the CLI's own tools from its init, the transcript has the own-tool line, and the payment question waits in the prompt slot (m0-agent-cli-question). n denies it; the task then waits, and Esc and s stop it, with the stopped line (m0-agent-cli-stopped). Each step waits for what `state` reports of the screen (the prompt line, the chat window's view, rows, entries and question, the status bar's agent segment, and no notice), never for a time, so a slow PATH search or CLI start cannot leave the 'agent: found claude' notice or a half-drawn transcript in a screenshot (#981). The transcript, header and status bar show the fixture server's fixed port (28471); setup's list shows a few characters of the profile's path, which vary between runs, well inside the 0.5 % screenshot tolerance.

steps.keys: : a g e n t space m o d e l enter
k k k j j enter
